goal: Implement BIP 54 Consensus Cleanup rules to address legacy vulnerabilities like sigops CPU exhaustion
Protect against 64-byte Merkle tree collisions and timewarp difficulty manipulation attacks
Enable testing and evaluation of the rules upstream on regtest without activating on mainnet
agreement: Strong support with no open objections after addressing mutation test findings
Strong support based on extensive mutation testing across all BIP 54 rules (instagibbs)
Verified sigop counting, size, timestamp, and coinbase vectors against btclib and BIP text (fametrano)
Concept approval for implementing the functionality upstream without mainnet activation (0xB10C)
Open question on potential cache or mempool reorg edge cases under the new rules (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes consensus vulnerabilities like quadratic sigops DoS and timewarp attacks
It provides an upstream testing harness and evaluation path for BIP 54 validation rules
The rules are only active on regtest, so it does not immediately affect production networks
